close_reason: self-issued NC exemption and pathLenConstraint exemption implemented; all 5 PKITS tests now pass
description: RFC 5280 §4.2.1.9: self-issued intermediate certificates do not count against pathLenConstraint. pkix-path chain_walk counts all intermediates regardless of self-issuance. PKITS 4.6.15-17 are explicitly ignored. Current behavior is fail-closed (over-rejects valid cross-cert chains) so it is not a security hole today. The risk is in the fix: implementing the exemption requires accurately identifying self-issued certs (issuer == subject per RFC 5280 §3.3, not just byte equality) and excluding them from the (i-1) count. An incorrect implementation could undercount, allowing chains that exceed the constraint. The fix touches the core path-length check and needs its own PKITS test suite coverage before merging. File a sub-issue with the test vectors and the correct formula before touching chain_walk.
title: pathLenConstraint self-issued exemption absent — future fix likely to introduce undercount
